_about: The survivor's standing orders: one objective at a time, in order, shown on the HUD card. Every condition is read from state the player can already see (bag contents, bonded animals, which island you are on), so no system has to report completion. Rewards are pioneer XP and T-stones. Added 2026-09-22 after a bot playthrough found the early game had no stated goal at all. HUDRULES 2026-10-28: an optional 'fight' list names the creature ids whose fight serves the order ('*' = any wild animal); the HUD keeps the order card up in combat only then.
_tutorial_about: TUTORIAL ISLAND (owner 2026-10-28): the first orders a NEW survivor follows on the shared tutorial island (data/islands/tutorial_isle.json), one system per step. Objectives uses this list while World.tutorial.done is false; the last step (grant_home) opens the Tamed Island pick and ferries the survivor home, then the standing orders below continue from 'tutorial_resume_at'. Extra conditions: near (camp|guild|harbour, radius m), status (a status id is active), resting, did (counts the tutorial records: eat, eat:<item>, kill, build, skill), fire_lit (a fire on this island is burning). point_at is the onboarding pointer: 'ui:<HUD node name>', 'ctx:<context action id>', 'world:camp|guild|bench|firepit|harbour|creature|corpse|water', 'harvest:<item>'; 'a|b' tries a then b; 'have:<item>=X' uses X only while the bag holds the item. Taming is not a tutorial step: vision section 1 says the first bond is discovered in open play, not a guided award.

tutorial.title: Report to the Adventurer's Guild
tutorial.hint: Tap the ground or use WASD: the guild hall is in the town up from the dock. Tap it for your orders

tutorial._assumption: ASSUMPTION (TASKSCREEN TS13, owner go 2026-10-29): order rewards wait in Tasks until Receive, so the tutorial teaches it right after the first reward.
tutorial.title: Claim your reward in Tasks
tutorial.hint: MENU > Tasks: press Receive on the finished order

tutorial.title: Gather 3 branches
tutorial.hint: Tap a tree and pick Branch from the wheel

tutorial.title: Pick up 2 stones
tutorial.hint: Loose rock comes up by hand

tutorial.title: Strip 4 plant fibre
tutorial.hint: Bushes and wild grass, no tool needed

tutorial.title: Drink fresh water
tutorial.hint: Out through the north gate to the stream, then tap Drink

tutorial.title: Eat some berries
tutorial.hint: Pick berries, then BAG > tap Berries > Use: Eat

tutorial.title: Sit down and rest
tutorial.hint: Tap Rest: sitting recovers fatigue

tutorial.title: Twist fibre into twine
tutorial.hint: MENU > Craft > Materials (first tab) > Twine > Craft: 2 fibre twist into twine by hand

tutorial.title: Knap a work knife
tutorial.hint: MENU > Craft > Tool tab > Work Knife > Craft: a stone, a branch and twine, by hand. The work knife butchers carcasses; it never fights

tutorial.title: Make a work axe at the bench
tutorial.hint: Tap the town workbench > CRAFT > Tool tab > Work Axe > Craft: a stone, a branch and twine (twist 2 more fibre first)

tutorial.title: Make a stone dagger at the bench
tutorial.hint: Tap the town workbench > CRAFT > Weapon tab > Stone Dagger > Craft: a stone, a branch and twine (twist 2 more fibre first). The dagger fights, so the work knife stays sharp for butchering

tutorial.title: Fell 2 wood logs
tutorial.hint: The axe opens Wood Log on any tree

tutorial.title: Hunt a compsognathus
tutorial.hint: Small and quick. Tap it, then ATTACK

tutorial.title: Butcher the carcass for meat
tutorial.hint: Stand by the body and tap Loot

tutorial.title: Light the fire pit
tutorial.hint: Tap the stone fire pit by the guild > FUEL > add a Branch: it burns while fuelled

tutorial.title: Cook a Herb Roast
tutorial.hint: Tap the burning fire pit > COOK > Cooking tab > Herbed Meal > Craft: meat (main) + herb (topping) + a branch

tutorial.title: Eat the Herb Roast
tutorial.hint: BAG > tap the Herbed Meal > Use: Eat, then watch its buff in the status row

tutorial.title: Learn a skill
tutorial.hint: MENU > Skills > a skill with a gold dot > the gold Learn button at the bottom

tutorial.title: Build a straw bedroll
tutorial.hint: MENU > Craft > Building Components tab > Straw Roll > Craft (3 fibre, 1 twine), then MENU > Craft > Build (the very bottom) > Straw Roll, and place it at the camp

tutorial.title: Board the ferry to your own island
tutorial.hint: Walk onto the dock: you will choose your Tamed Island and sail there

_tutorial_menu_about: MENU GUIDANCE (owner 2026-10-29): an order done inside a menu lists its taps under 'menu' (alternatives, each optionally led by 'have:<item>'); Tutorial.guide rings the deepest element on screen, opens the right tab before the entry, scrolls the entry into view or shows a scroll cue. The hint names the same tab and entry. # ASSUMPTION: paths and hint wording (open question TT4).
